description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Separator' which renders a separator line using Radix UI's SeparatorPrimitive. It provides customizable orientation, styling, and accessibility options, and exports the component for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: Separator
methods.description: A React component that renders a styled separator line, supporting horizontal and vertical orientations, with optional decorative attribute for accessibility and styling purposes.
